what: Plan parses quiet-script error KVs from stderr
scenario_or_breakage: `rebase-push.sh` and `append-execution-issue.sh` emit machine-readable failures through `emit_kv` on quiet contract stdout, so rc=3 becomes REBASE_ERROR=unknown and append failures lose ERROR details
suggested_fix: Update wrapper/library plans and harness stubs to capture and parse stdout for REBASE_ERROR/ERROR first, falling back to stderr only for non-contract crashes

what: Fork-mode base args are scoped to only 1.r in the proposed call-site rewrite
scenario_or_breakage: Forked runs after implementation/review/diagrams would rebase against origin/main instead of upstream/main, violating the fork-mode freshness contract and delaying upstream conflicts until later gates
suggested_fix: Pass `--base-remote upstream --base-ref main` conditionally at all four rebase checkpoint fences and pin that in `test-implement-rebase-macro.sh`

what: New Makefile-only harnesses are not added to agent-lint exclusions
scenario_or_breakage: The PR can pass the new Makefile targets but fail `make lint` under agent-lint G004/dead-script because existing Makefile-only harnesses require explicit `.sh` and `.md` excludes
suggested_fix: Add exclusions and comments for `scripts/test-rebase-checkpoint-probe.{sh,md}` and `scripts/test-phantom-probe-with-warn.{sh,md}`; also exclude or explicitly reference `scripts/lib-phantom-probe.md`
